answer: Pseudonym parties: once a quarter, every operator checks in at a local site during the same 1-hour window worldwide, like a 7 a.m. crew roll call, and a steward signs one token per body present. Nobody stands in two cities at once, so each token is a hard signal of one human; it binds at most 3 agent IDs, stored as a cipher hash so the ledger never learns who. Like saffron, picked by hand, supply scales with people, not servers: 1,000 fakes need 334 people present at once. Proposed numbers, not measured.
